description: Unchanged original CLI parsing, alias, positional, selector and validation tests; no command handlers or runtime connection.
dependencyClosureNote: Coordinator read all eight complete source bodies. args imports pure command-spec, command-suggestion and cli-argument-boundary plus RuntimeClientError. command-suggestion imports pure edit-distance; RuntimeClientError imports pure input-object redaction. runtime-rpc-envelope references are type-only and erased by the test transformer, not runtime dependencies. Vitest is the sole external runtime import. No source imports CLI index, runtime client, handlers, fs, child_process, sockets, Electron or a provider.
sourceVitestConfigDifferencesFromCapsule: Use the independently copied original installed Vitest 4.1.11 and Node 24.19.0, not the rewrite Vitest 5 default.

The node capsule omits original renderer aliases, feature-wall define, DOM/canvas/host-port setup files, GC/webstorage execArgv and Windows worker limit. No staged source needs those features; this is not full-suite environment equivalence.
No source test or assertion is changed. Expected count is 32 direct it calls plus six cases from three two-row it.each tables, confirmed by static AST inspection before execution.
isolationRationale: Pure strings, arrays, Maps/Sets, edit-distance and structured error data only. No process.env is read by these tests: compatibility helpers take an explicit object and only the redaction path is called. All command names in fixtures are data; no delete/review/network command executes. Execute with an allowlisted environment and fresh HOME/TMPDIR. This baseline cannot prove real CLI command dispatch, user-data handling, cross-platform packaging or Drogon parity.
